evals.query: In my Tauri 2 app the frontend must read a JSON settings file stored in the app data directory using @tauri-apps/plugin-fs. Show me everything I need to add: Rust, npm, config and JS.
expected_behavior: Adds the fs plugin with both the crate and the npm package, and registers it with .plugin(tauri_plugin_fs::init()) on the builder
Grants access through a capability file under src-tauri/capabilities/ that targets the window by label, not through a Tauri 1 allowlist
Grants a read permission together with a scope on $APPDATA (or the matching BaseDirectory), and states that a permission without a scope fails with a forbidden path error
Reads the file with readTextFile and baseDir: BaseDirectory.AppData instead of building an absolute path by hand
Says the npm package and the crate of the plugin must stay on matching versions

evals.query: I need to stream download progress from a long-running Rust command to my Tauri 2 frontend and also read a value from managed state inside that async command. Write the Rust command and the JS call.
expected_behavior: Uses tauri::ipc::Channel passed as a command argument for the progress stream, and explains channels are preferred over events for ordered or streamed data
Makes the async command that takes State<'_, T> or borrowed arguments return a Result
Registers the command in a single generate_handler! inside one invoke_handler call
Calls invoke from @tauri-apps/api/core with camelCase argument keys and a new Channel with an onmessage handler
Uses app.manage with a Mutex for mutable state without wrapping it in Arc, and names the runtime failure of a mismatched State type

evals.query: Set up auto-updates for my Tauri 2 desktop app distributed through GitHub Releases. What keys, config and code do I need?
expected_behavior: Generates a signing key pair with the tauri signer command and puts the public key content (not a path) in plugins.updater.pubkey
Says TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY must be set as a real environment variable at build time and that a .env file is not read
Enables bundle.createUpdaterArtifacts so the build emits the signatures
Grants the updater permission in a capability and calls check() then downloadAndInstall() from app code, stating nothing checks automatically
Warns that losing the private key prevents shipping updates to installed users

evals.query: I am porting a Tauri 1 app to Tauri 2. It uses the allowlist, imports invoke from @tauri-apps/api/tauri, and on Windows stores user data in localStorage. What breaks and what do I change?
expected_behavior: Recommends running the tauri migrate command first, then reviewing its output
Replaces the allowlist with capabilities and permissions, and moves APIs that left the core to their plugins
Changes the import to @tauri-apps/api/core
Warns that the Windows origin moves from https://tauri.localhost to http://tauri.localhost, which loses localStorage and IndexedDB, and gives app.windows[].useHttpsScheme: true as the fix
